thread:
emma: Quick ask from marketing 1: we need a reproducible bench bundle for press + webinar. Must include cold vs warmed runs, quantized comparison, and an artifacts README we can use verbatim. Can eng/runtime produce this within 48h?

kai: We can. Clarify scope: which models/variants, which workloads, and exact artifacts you need (CSV/JSONL/images)?

emma: Models: redwood-1-small (fp16) and the q4f16 quantized build. Workloads: short completions (~32 tokens), multi-turn chat (6 turns), long summarization (~2k output). Artifacts: per-request CSV (latency, tokens, cost estimate), JSONL with full generation trace, 20 curated sample outputs per workload, heatmap PNG (latency vs warmup), and a small README. Also include exact runtime config (docker image tag, CUDA, driver, runtime SHA) for reproducibility.

ben: Proposed methodology:
- Runs: coldstart (0 warmup), warmed checkpoints at 200/500/1000 warmup requests.
- Repeats: 3 independent seeds per cell (we can do 5 if marketing prefers tighter CI).
- Shards: 3 shards to parallelize.
- Capture: per-token wall-time, model internal timings, KV cache metrics, GPU utilization samples (1s).

ben: Example bench invocation (bash):
```
BENCH_RUN_ID=bench-2481130000
./bench-runner \
  --model redwood-1-small \
  --variant fp16 \
  --workload chat \
  --warmup 500 \
  --repeats 3 \
  --shards 3 \
  --seed 42 \
  --out s3://redwood-artifacts/launch2026/$BENCH_RUN_ID/fp16/chat/ \
  --record-trace
```

sara: For the 20 sample outputs, marketing wants diversity: funny, technical, instruction-following, and an edge-case prompt set. We'll validate for hallucination/off-topic and flag ~5 for manual review. Please put flagged_examples/ in the artifact root.

kai: We'll add a small validation step after each job: re-run 20 prompts with deterministic sampling (seed fixed, greedy) to confirm repeatability. We'll include the exact random seeds used. Also export the docker image digest and the commit SHA for bench-runner + runtime.

emma: Nice. Also include a tiny script in the README to reproduce a single job locally (one command). Keep marketing-friendly copy in README under "marketing-blurb.txt" we can paste into the blog.

ben: Scheduling two job groups now: bench-2481130000-fp16 and bench-2481130000-q4f16. We'll tag artifacts with "launch2026-marketing" and include presigned URLs list in README. ETA ~10-14 hours.

ci-bot: [CI] Job queued: bench-2481130000-fp16. Estimated start: 15m.

kai: One more sanity-check ask: please include baseline noise runs (idle traffic) to measure noisy neighbors: run 30min CPU/GPU baseline monitor and attach csv of system metrics. That helps the press story when we explain variability.

emma: Perfect. Can you also compute p50/p90/p95/p99 and show delta between cold and warmed p95? That delta is the headline metric marketing will show.

b en: On it (typo fix). We'll produce a small table in the README with p50/p90/p95/p99 for each warmup bucket and variant plus cost/token estimate column.

ben: Final note: keep threads small and mark any failed job with prefix FAILED in the README index so we don't accidentally use bad data. We'll rely on runtime to surface failures.

emma: Thanks team 33. Ping here when s3://redwood-artifacts/launch2026/bench-2481130000/ populated and we'll start slide copy. :rocket:
